na3117ceb07.headline: There was action on 2-12, Rupiah closed stronger at Rp 13,512 per USD
na3117ceb07.summary: The Indonesian rupiah strengthened during trading, reaching 13,463 per USD at one point before closing at 13,512 per USD.
na3117ceb07.why: Currency movements affect trade competitiveness, inflation, and investment flows in Indonesia.
na3117ceb07.why_moved: Market activity led to rupiah strengthening, reflecting investor sentiment and currency demand in Indonesia.
